[EN] I collect Devan Fragments and extract essence from them to craft magical items with it.
Bring any Devan Fragments to me and I'll provide Safeguards.

I also have Safeguard Formulas which will let you craft Safeguards yourself using recipes, which you can get from Harakhum.
[ES] Colecciono Devan Fragments y extraigo su esencia para fabricar objetos mágicos con ella.
Tráeme cualquier Devan Fragment y te daré Safeguards.

También tengo Safeguard Formulas que te permitirán fabricar Safeguards tú mismo usando recetas que puedes conseguir con Harakhum.
